game_concept: A speed quiz set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the larder door.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the larder door. Each round, a new warm lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the vault value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of warm lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Aurora Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 180 within 36 seconds.
